meta.listDescription: Deadlock regional leaderboards and player search, with current ranks and public profiles.
meta.detailDescription: Public Deadlock profile for player {id}: current rank, win rates, hero pool, teammates and match history.

list.title: Players
list.description: Find a player by Steam name or SteamID3. Profiles show public data only.
list.promptDescription: Enter a Steam name or a SteamID3. Only players with recent matches are listed.
list.noResultsDescription: No public profiles match “{query}” with these filters.
list.teamAverageNote: “Recent team average” is the average rank of the player’s last match teams, not the player’s own rank. Open a profile for their current rank.

profile.basis: Based on {counted} normal-mode matches stored by the data source
profile.basisSince: Based on {counted} normal-mode matches stored by the data source since {date}
profile.excluded: ; {count, plural, one {# match with a penalized or not-scored outcome isn’t counted in win rates} other {# matches with a penalized or not-scored outcome aren’t counted in win rates}}
profile.summary: {basis}{excluded}. History may be incomplete. These are results, not a skill rating.
profile.recentDescription: The {count} most recent stored normal-mode matches.
profile.trendDescription: Win rate over time, plus rank after each ranked match where Valve reported one.
profile.poolDescription: Most-played heroes (all stored normal-mode matches). Small samples are muted.
profile.matesDescription: Players most often on the same team (10+ shared matches). Win rate = this player’s results together.
profile.enemiesDescription: Players most often faced (5+ matches). Win rate = this player’s results against them.
profile.notFoundDescription: No public profile or stored matches for this account. Private or protected accounts aren’t shown.

trend.tooFew: Fewer than {count} counted matches, so there is no trend to show.
trend.legend: Each bar is {count} consecutive matches (oldest left, newest highlighted). Scale {scale}; dashed line 50%; whisker = 95% interval.
trend.noChange: The latest block isn’t clearly different from the one before.
trend.changed: The latest block is clearly {direction, select, higher {higher} other {lower}} than the one before (intervals don’t overlap).

rankHistory.tooFew: Not enough ranked matches with a reported rank to chart.
rankHistory.chart: Rank went from {first} to {last} over the last {count} ranked matches.
rankHistory.caption: {first} → {last} across the last {count} ranked matches with a reported rank ({from} – {to}).

pool.empty: No hero statistics for this player.
